tools.name: list_exports_skill_files
tools.title: List Exports Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'exports' skill, the platform's guidance for generating downloadable documents, sending email, and scheduling recurring jobs from an app. Call this when the user asks to export query results, generate a PDF/Word/Excel report or invoice, download data as CSV, email a report or notification, or run something nightly/weekly on a schedule, and when they name ToPdf, ToDocx, ToExcel, ToCsv, TableToXLSX, EncryptPdf, SendEmail, ScheduleJob, cron, or SchedulerHistory. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for downloading an existing file (DownloadAsset, see the app-bootstrap skill) or for durable file storage (see the app-data skill).

project.title: project
project.description: The exports skill (exports). Always this value.

tools.name: read_exports_skill_file
tools.title: Read Exports Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'exports' skill in full, for writing code that generates documents, sends email, or schedules jobs through runPixel. Pass filePath exactly as list_exports_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers the download-key pattern shared by all generators, ToPdf/ToDocx from HTML or markdown with mustache templating and page numbers, piping a SqlQuery or Frame task into ToCsv/ToExcel, SendEmail with attachments from the insight space, the Quartz scheduler pixels (jobGroup is the project id), and what a headless scheduled recipe can and cannot do.

project.title: project
project.description: The exports skill (exports). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_exports_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
